script.speaker: student
script.text: Excuse me. Where are the English books?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: They are on the second floor. Go up the stairs.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Is the study room there too?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: No. The study room is on the first floor, next to the door.

question.explain_tr: Görevli kitaplar için 'second floor' diyor. 'First floor' ve 'next to the door' çalışma odasını anlatıyor.
question.key_line: They are on the second floor.
